g.text: Items: exact selections and saved views
Both review and implementation Items use one admission and selection path.
ResolveSelection: declared hops at saved revisions,
evidence by stable id, contained range; stable
Load: rev → full OID, Saga manifest at that commit
must match identity/source, inventory extracted via
git ls-tree + cat-file; specific refusal reasons
add-item / revise-item: --documentation-view, --selections, --repo; apply-slide items: documentation_view, selections
omitted commit → containing evidence commit; precheck names wrong hops; selected bytes digested; AdmitPin
transactions author before the lock so retries replay; unchanged pins, views and selections are retained
Removed: requireDocumentation. Its current-only rule is now AdmitPin without a view, with the same "is stale" message.
